description: Discover congressional members and their legislative activity. No name search. For 'list', filter by stateCode (optionally with district), by congress, or by both together (e.g., 118th Congress + CA, or CA district 12 in the 118th). Add currentMember=true to restrict to currently serving members. Once you have a bioguideId, use 'get' for full profile or 'sponsored'/'cosponsored' for their legislative portfolio. A 'sponsored'/'cosponsored' row that is an amendment carries amendmentNumber, with its amendment type in the row's url (/amendment/{congress}/{type}/{number}); pass congress, amendmentType, and amendmentNumber to congressgov_amendment_lookup for its sponsor, actions, and text.

bioguideId.description: Unique member identifier (e.g., 'P000197'). Required for get/sponsored/cosponsored; 'list' refuses it.

congress.description: Congress number to filter by, for 'list' only — Congress.gov offers no congress filter on a member's sponsored or cosponsored legislation.

currentMember.description: Filter to currently serving members, for 'list' only. Omit to include both current and former members.

district.description: Congressional district number, for 'list' only. Requires stateCode. Use 0 for at-large.

name: congressgov_member_lookup

data.description: Result rows. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

items.description: Upstream JSON record. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: A requested bill, member, committee, report, vote, or nomination does not exist in Congress.gov. `rate_limited`: A process-local attempt budget or the shared upstream credential/IP quota was reached; upstream hourly limits vary and DEMO_KEY also has a daily quota. On a Senate vote the LIS feed could not answer, Voteview answering HTTP 429 is reported the same way. `invalid_request`: Congress.gov rejected the request as malformed — a bad date range or an identifier with an unexpected shape. `api_key_rejected`: The api.data.gov gateway rejected the server's configured CONGRESS_API_KEY (missing, invalid, disabled, unauthorized, or unverified); the gateway code is in data.upstreamCode. No change to the call's arguments can fix it. `upstream_error`: Congress.gov returned an unexpected error (5xx or another non-2xx status) or could not be reached, or a Senate vote could be read from neither the Senate LIS feed nor its Voteview fallback (before the 101st Congress there is no fallback, and there a senate.gov HTTP 403 refusal carries retryable: false). `upstream_timeout`: A Congress.gov request or a congress.gov document fetch timed out or returned an HTTP timeout response, or the call's upstream requests could not finish inside its 50-second budget. `incompatible_identity`: A list operation carries an entity identifier that only a detail operation uses. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.
